Summary: IExternalApplication (App) is not registered in the .addin manifest – ribbon tab/button is never created so the command has no UI entry point in Revit
EvidenceMethod: manifest contains only AddIn Type="Command"; App.OnStartup builds the ribbon
Impact: Add-in loads but is invisible in the Revit ribbon; users can only run it via AddInManager-type tools
RecommendedFix: Add a second <AddIn Type="Application"> entry with FullClassName MEPAutoRouting.Core.App (new GUID) to MEPAutoRouting.addin

Summary: UserSettings and RoutingOptions persist to the SAME file (%AppData%\MEPAutoRouting\settings.json); SaveSettings writes UserSettings then RoutingOptions, so UserSettings (discipline, strategy, lead, topmost, etc.) are lost on every close
EvidenceLines: UserSettings.cs L23-L26; RoutingOptions.cs L30-L35; MainViewModel.cs L228-L235
Impact: All UserSettings revert to defaults each session; Topmost/discipline/strategy never persist
RecommendedFix: Give RoutingOptions its own file (e.g. constraints.json) or merge both into one DTO

Summary: Deployed DLL mismatch: Debug auto-deploy (csproj DeployToRevit) copies to Addins\2025\MEPAutoRouting\ subfolder, but the manifest resolves MEPAutoRouting.dll from the addins ROOT; the root DLL is currently a stale Debug build (10/6 10:18) while the newest build sits unloaded in the subfolder
EvidenceMethod: csproj target destination vs manifest relative Assembly path; folder listing
Impact: Revit loads stale code after every Debug build; 'fixed' bugs appear unfixed
RecommendedFix: Make DeployToRevit copy to the addins root (or change manifest Assembly to MEPAutoRouting\MEPAutoRouting.dll); redeploy Release

Summary: Slope is applied AFTER PathValidator.Validate and is never re-validated: the sloped path is not re-checked against walls, boundary or vertical limits, and sloped segments are not axis-aligned for elbow validation
EvidenceMethod: call order: Validate (allowSlope:false) L162, SlopeApplier.Apply L167
Impact: A collision-free horizontal route can become invalid/through-wall or below-limit after slope; elbows may fail at commit
RecommendedFix: Re-run PathValidator with allowSlope:true and constraints.IsBlocked after SlopeApplier; add vertical-limit check

Summary: Obstacle model only covers walls + columns + structural framing: floors, MEP equipment/fixtures, pipes, ducts, conduits, cable trays, fittings, generic models are never obstacles; routes can pass through equipment bodies and mid-level slabs
EvidenceMethod: GetFilteredObstacles collects only OST_Columns/OST_StructuralColumns/OST_StructuralFraming; GeometryExtractor skips Wall
Impact: No-path false negatives avoided but real collisions with equipment/floors possible
RecommendedFix: Add floors + MEP equipment categories (host+link) to obstacle extraction; keep exempt corridors only around selected connectors

Summary: Pick-request race: RoutingEventHandler.Request is a shared mutable field set on the UI thread and read when the queued action executes; two quick picks overwrite the request so the first pick is lost/mis-executed
Impact: Wrong connector picked or pick silently dropped when clicking fast
RecommendedFix: Capture the request in the queued closure (app => Pick(uidoc, vm, isSource)) instead of the shared field

Summary: Duct and cable-tray nominal size bug: ApplyNominalSize uses RBS_PIPE_DIAMETER_PARAM for every discipline except Conduit, so custom sizes are silently never applied to ducts (RBS_CURVE_DIAMETER_PARAM) or cable trays (width/height)
Impact: Routed ducts/cable trays keep type default size despite user input
RecommendedFix: Branch per discipline: duct -> RBS_CURVE_DIAMETER_PARAM (or W/H), cable tray -> RBS_CABLETRAY_WIDTH/HEIGHT_PARAM

Summary: Strategy combo and Elevation Offset textbox are UI-only: RouteRequest carries no Strategy/Elevation; RouteService always runs A*; RoutePlanner (which consumed Strategy) is legacy
EvidenceMethod: RouteRequest fields L13-L30 have no Strategy; RoutePlanner.Plan has no callers
EvidenceLines: RouteService.cs L13-L30; RoutePlanner.cs L16-L55; MainWindow.xaml Routing Options tab
Impact: Users believe strategy/elevation affect routing; they do nothing
RecommendedFix: Remove the controls or wire Strategy into RouteService as start-direction bias

Summary: Legacy Revit 2024 manifest still deployed (%AppData%\...\Addins\2024\MEPAutoRouting.addin, FullClassName MEPAutoRouting.UnifiedRoutingCommand, absolute 2024 path) although Deploy-Revit2025.ps1 tries to delete it
Impact: Revit 2024 (if installed) tries to load an incompatible/absent DLL; confusion about which version is current
RecommendedFix: Delete the 2024 manifest once and verify; keep the removal step in the deploy script

Summary: No cancellation and Revit-thread search: A* (up to 400k iterations) + full-grid BFS run inside ExternalEvent on Revit's main thread; large regions freeze Revit UI for the whole search
EvidenceMethod: MaxIterations L29; BFS before A* L135; queue Execute on Revit thread
Impact: Revit appears hung during long searches; user cannot cancel
RecommendedFix: Add a CancellationToken checked per iteration, wire a Cancel button; consider time-boxed search

Summary: Bounding-box-only collision for columns/framing: rotated or irregular elements block their whole AABB (false blockage) and AABB checks can miss nothing-but-corners cases; no solid-level narrow-phase
EvidenceMethod: CheckIfObstacle AABB test L438-L451; GetBoundingBoxes AABB only
Impact: False no-path near rotated columns; coarse routes
RecommendedFix: Use solid intersection (SolidVolume.Hits-style) for narrow phase on filtered candidates

Summary: Preview (Path Preview tab) is cleared only at route start / failure / connector change; changing boundary, slope, size, type or system type leaves a stale preview list
Impact: Stale path shown after parameter change until next run
RecommendedFix: Clear PreviewPoints in setters of Boundary/slope/size/type/system

Summary: Total fall (TotalFallText) is not reset when the selection is cleared: OnConnectorsChanged resets summary but never resets _totalFallFt nor raises TotalFallText
Impact: Summary shows stale total fall after Clear
RecommendedFix: Reset _totalFallFt and raise TotalFallText in OnConnectorsChanged/ClearSelection

Summary: No same-element / same-connector guard: picking the identical connector as source and target yields the misleading error 'No path found – source/target enclosed by walls'
EvidenceMethod: no Source==Target precheck; start.DistanceTo(end)<0.001 returns empty path
Impact: Confusing diagnostic
RecommendedFix: Add precheck: identical owner+connector or distance<tol -> explicit error message

Summary: SelectAfterRoute setting is persisted and shown in Settings but never used – created elements are never selected in Revit
EvidenceMethod: property exists L198; no usage in RouteService/RouteBuilder; RouteResult.Created ids not propagated
Impact: Misleading setting
RecommendedFix: Implement uidoc.Selection.SetElementIds(result.Created) after commit, or remove the setting

Summary: RouteBlockedReason does not cover 'no type selected'; RouteCommand.CanExecute also requires SelectedType, so the log can only say 'CanExecute returned false'
EvidenceMethod: RouteBlockedReason cases L446-L451; CanExecute in MainViewModel.cs L55; RunCommand message
Impact: Incomplete explanation why Route is unavailable
RecommendedFix: Add SelectedType==null case to RouteBlockedReason

Summary: Inconsistent link transforms: GeometryExtractor uses RevitLinkInstance.GetTransform() while WallObstacleCollector and BoundaryPicker use GetTotalTransform()
EvidenceLines: GeometryExtractor.cs L73; WallObstacle.cs L49; BoundaryPicker.cs L37
Impact: Sub-mm to real offsets for nested/transformed link setups
RecommendedFix: Use GetTotalTransform() everywhere

Summary: SpaceVolume assumes the link has no rotation for Z ('假設 link 冇傾斜') – Z is shifted by t.OfPoint(Zero).Z only; rotated links produce wrong MinZ/MaxZ
Impact: Wrong vertical band for boundaries in rotated links
RecommendedFix: Transform the Z range by the full basis or document the limitation

Summary: MainViewModel scalar properties (IsBusy, Status, DocumentTitle) are set on the Revit thread inside RoutingEventHandler.Execute; WPF auto-marshal makes this work today but it is fragile for future collection updates
Impact: Potential cross-thread issues if collections are later touched there
RecommendedFix: Route all VM mutations through PostToUi

Summary: Dead/legacy code compiled into the assembly: RoutePlanner.Plan/Simplify/Validate (only DirectionLabel used), RoutingVolumeUtils (no callers), WarningSwallower (no callers), MainViewModel.SetPreview and BuildOptions (no callers), SlopeApplier.TotalFall (no callers)
EvidenceLines: RoutePlanner.cs L16-L55; RoutingVolumeUtils.cs all; WarningSwallower.cs all; MainViewModel.cs L201-L216,L260-L296; SlopeApplier.cs L97

Summary: Stale documentation: README_BUILD.txt names MEPAutoRouting.UnifiedRoutingCommand as the active command; README_CONNECTOR_ROUTING.txt describes net48/Revit 2024 install; stray 'gitignore' file (no dot) is never read by git
